name: AI UI Style Vault 3D Production Resource Intelligence
principle: Choose production resources only after the 3D subject, business purpose and required deliverable are known. Resource discovery never justifies 3D by itself.

categories.label: Procedural Terrain & Landscape
categories.summary: Create terrain, landscape meshes, heightfields and environment bases for verified or clearly conceptual place-led experiences.
workflow: Confirm whether the landscape is verified real-world or conceptual.
Use authoritative height/GIS data when accuracy matters.
Generate or sculpt terrain at production resolution.
Decimate/retopologize and bake detail for web delivery.
Export a bounded GLB/mesh plus a static fallback.
avoid: inventing a real property's terrain
shipping raw production-density terrain to the browser

categories.label: Vegetation & Procedural Nature
categories.summary: Produce trees, bushes, moss, snow and other environmental detail for living-world or place-led scenes.
workflow: Define whether vegetation is decorative, approximate or site-accurate.
Generate reusable low/medium-poly assets or instancing systems.
Bake materials and impostors where appropriate.
Cap instance counts by capability tier.
Provide a reduced-motion/static environment fallback.
avoid: claiming procedural flora is an exact real-world survey
unbounded instance counts

categories.label: Architecture & Building Generation
categories.summary: Create or block out buildings, interiors, infrastructure and procedural architectural systems.
workflow: Prefer owner CAD/BIM/floor plans when depicting a real development.
Use procedural tools for blockout or clearly conceptual design.
Separate collision/navigation geometry from visual detail.
Bake/merge static detail for web performance.
Export verified dimensions and scene scale.
avoid: using generic generated architecture as verified property geometry
mixing incompatible scene scales

categories.label: Photogrammetry & 3D Reconstruction
categories.summary: Reconstruct physical objects, places or surfaces from approved photographs or scans when real-world fidelity matters.
workflow: Confirm ownership/permission for the source photographs and location/object capture.
Reconstruct at high quality outside the web runtime.
Clean topology, holes, scale and texture seams in Blender.
Create a web-optimized derivative with baked maps.
Preserve the original high-fidelity source separately from the delivery asset.
avoid: scanning people/locations without permission
shipping raw scan meshes and 8K textures directly to web

categories.label: Point Cloud, LiDAR & Spatial Data
categories.summary: Work with measured point clouds, LiDAR and elevation data for accurate spatial context and digital-twin foundations.
workflow: Verify dataset provenance, coordinate reference system and usage terms.
Crop to the business-relevant area.
Convert or reconstruct only the geometry needed for the experience.
Record scale/origin transformations.
Create low-cost browser representations and an accessible non-3D equivalent.

resourceCandidates.name: blender_kitti
resourceCandidates.role: large point clouds and voxel grids

avoid: assuming public data is unrestricted
losing coordinate/scale metadata during conversion

categories.label: Materials, Textures & PBR Baking
categories.summary: Create, paint, derive and optimize PBR materials for products, environments and scanned assets.
workflow: Define material truth requirements and source rights.
Author/paint at production resolution.
Bake procedural/high-poly detail to web-ready maps.
Atlas and compress textures by device tier.
Check color space, UV seams and material consistency after GLB export.
avoid: using unlicensed texture packs
uncompressed oversized texture sets

categories.label: Lighting, HDRI & Environment Lookdev
categories.summary: Create believable lighting, HDRI alignment and environment look-development before baking or exporting web-ready lighting.
workflow: Match the lighting goal to the real product/place or approved art direction.
Use licensed HDRIs/environment sources.
Tune exposure/white balance/material response in Blender.
Bake static lighting when possible for web.
Provide lower-cost environment maps for mobile.
avoid: using HDRIs without verifying redistribution/embedding rights
multiple expensive real-time lights where baked light works

categories.label: Simulation & Physics
categories.summary: Create offline fluid, particle, collision and physical effects that can be baked into efficient web animation or media.
workflow: Decide whether the effect must be real-time or can be baked.
Simulate offline at the quality needed for the shot/interaction.
Reduce caches to the smallest sufficient delivery representation.
Prefer image/video/mesh sequences over browser physics when interaction is not required.
Provide reduced-motion and static fallbacks.
avoid: running production-grade Blender physics in the browser
motion that ignores reduced-motion preferences

categories.label: Characters, Humans & Face/Body Generation
categories.summary: Produce human/character bases for approved fictional, avatar or demonstrative use while keeping identity and rights explicit.
workflow: Establish whether the character is fictional, generic, user-owned or represents a real person.
Verify tool/model output rights and likeness permissions.
Generate/model at appropriate topology density.
Rig/retarget only required motions.
Create privacy-safe and performance-safe web derivatives.
avoid: creating a real person's likeness without permission
using generator defaults as a business's real staff/customer imagery

categories.label: Animation, Mocap & Camera Motion
categories.summary: Create or capture character/object/camera motion, then retarget and simplify it for the selected immersive experience.
workflow: Define the exact state/interaction that needs motion.
Capture or author only necessary clips.
Clean loops, root motion and retargeting.
Reduce keyframes/bones where possible for web.
Test touch/keyboard states and reduced-motion alternatives.
avoid: unnecessary perpetual character motion
frame-dependent animations that cannot reach deterministic endpoints

categories.label: Geographic, GIS & Map Production
categories.summary: Bring geographic and map data into Blender for verified spatial context, route stories and place-based experiences.
workflow: Choose an authoritative/licensed map or GIS source.
Record coordinate reference system and source date.
Import only the relevant area/layers.
Simplify buildings/roads/terrain for web.
Keep an accessible 2D map/list alternative.
avoid: bypassing map-platform terms
presenting stale or approximate map geometry as current authoritative data

categories.label: Web Export, glTF & Interactive Delivery
categories.summary: Convert approved Blender assets into interoperable web formats or interactive pipelines while preserving scale, materials and animation.
workflow: Freeze approved scale/origin/naming conventions.
Bake unsupported procedural materials and modifiers.
Export to glTF/GLB when suitable.
Run mesh, texture and animation optimization.
Validate in the actual browser runtime and fallback path.
avoid: assuming Blender shaders transfer perfectly to the browser
exporting full production scenes without optimization

categories.label: Asset Libraries & Production Management
categories.summary: Discover, organize and reuse assets/materials while keeping per-asset provenance and license records.
workflow: Search by production need rather than visual novelty.
Verify every asset's individual license and provenance.
Store source URL, author, license, modifications and project usage.
Create optimized derivatives without deleting source attribution records.
Do not vendor restricted assets into the Vault.
avoid: treating platform availability as a reuse license
losing attribution/provenance when baking derivatives

categories.label: Rendering, Baking & Production Optimization
categories.summary: Manage renders, denoising and production performance when creating baked media, textures or offline sequences for immersive sites.
workflow: Determine whether the website needs real-time 3D or pre-rendered media.
Benchmark representative frames before committing to a long render.
Use denoising and resolution appropriate to delivery size.
Compress final media and test network cost.
Keep web runtime budgets separate from Blender render budgets.
avoid: confusing offline render speed with browser FPS
shipping unnecessarily high-bitrate sequences

categories.label: 3D Data Visualization
categories.summary: Turn verified datasets into spatial or animated 3D representations without implying unsupported live telemetry.
workflow: Validate the dataset and what it is allowed to claim.
Choose 3D only when spatial depth materially improves comprehension.
Generate geometry/animation deterministically from data.
Keep accessible table/chart equivalents.
Label demo/synthetic data explicitly.
avoid: fake live telemetry
decorative 3D charts that reduce comprehension

categories.label: Sound, Foley & Spatial Audio Preparation
categories.summary: Prepare restrained audio feedback, ambience and edited sound assets for interactive 3D experiences.
workflow: Confirm audio is justified and user-initiated where required.
Use owned/licensed recordings or generated audio with clear rights.
Trim, normalize and compress outside the browser.
Cap simultaneous voices and provide persistent mute/volume controls.
Pause or reduce audio when the page is hidden.
avoid: autoplaying intrusive audio
using sound/music without separate content rights

categories.label: Format Conversion & Export Pipeline
categories.summary: Move geometry and animation between Blender, web and downstream tools while preserving units, axes, materials and metadata.
workflow: Define the canonical source format and delivery format.
Freeze scale, axis and naming conventions.
Test a representative asset through the full pipeline.
Bake unsupported modifiers/materials before export.
Verify animation, normals, tangents and texture paths in the target runtime.
avoid: assuming format conversion preserves every shader/constraint
changing unit scale silently

categories.label: Blender Scripting & Pipeline Development
categories.summary: Automate repetitive Blender production, validation, export and data-processing work with Python and supported APIs.
workflow: Automate only a stable, understood manual workflow.
Use Blender's documented Python API and pin supported Blender versions.
Keep destructive operations opt-in and reversible where possible.
Validate outputs with deterministic checks.
Do not embed credentials or account secrets in Blender files/scripts.
avoid: automating an undefined artistic decision
unreviewed scripts that download/execute arbitrary code
